feature.title: Local queue status
feature.description: Expose queue status without adding outbound data flows.

rfc.background: DEVNS is local-first and should not introduce outbound data flows for status display.
rfc.expectedOutcome: Users can inspect queue status locally with no network export.
nonGoals: Do not add telemetry, analytics, or training-data export.

requirements.statement: The implementation must not add outbound data export paths.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: No telemetry or training-data upload path is introduced.

dynamic: npm run devns -- eval run --mode M27_review_calibration --json
static: Review changed files for outbound data export.

git.head: head-scope

evidenceQuality.summary: Semantic review is required for scope-sensitive outbound data changes.

evidence.summary: Build passed but does not prove local-only scope.

lessons: Scope drift should be calibrated independently from style review.

projectRules.content: DEVNS is local-first. Review agents must block scope drift and outbound data export that is not in the approved RFC.

reviewInstructions: Act as a read-only code review agent.
Prioritize correctness, security, requirements drift, missing tests, and evidence gaps.
Return exactly one lane-result JSON object with grounded findings.

laneResult.summary: Review found scope drift through an outbound training-data upload path.

findings.message: The new script introduces an outbound data export path outside the approved local-only scope.

evidence.summary: REQ-SCOPE-001 says the implementation must not add outbound data export paths.

findings.suggestedFix: Remove the upload script or clarify and approve the outbound-data requirement before implementation.

evidence.summary: Reviewed RFC, diff, evidence quality, history, and project rules.

recommendedActions: Remove the outbound data path or run RFC clarification.
